summary: Live stuck predicate adopts an out-of-band 'canceling' batch (no processing_status guard) and later sync-retries operator-canceled ids, violating the plan's banned no-retry contract
evidence: judge_dispatch.py:876-897 (predicate lacks processing_status check; only 'ended' at :852 and overdue at :862 run first) -> :778-780 stamps stuck_cancel_intent_at before cancel -> :789 race guard accepts 'canceling' -> :707-708 gates canceled_ids into retry_candidates on the intent marker -> :1111/:1124 pins retry sync. Violates plan §5 'Out-of-band cancel' row, §11 item 4, Must-ask banned list ('retrying out-of-band-canceled ids'), and the :699 docstring. T13 (:533) / T15 (:566) cover only harvested payloads WITHOUT intent — adoption stamps intent, so battery stays green. Fix: 'and batch.processing_status == "in_progress"' in the fresh-entry predicate (resume elif keyed on existing intent unchanged) + regression test (first retrieve canceling, succeeded=0, elapsed>threshold, no intent -> no stamp, no retry). Origin: epm:code-review-codex v1 Major; upheld epm:review-reconcile v1.
